name: Paladin Paragon Freeman
body:
Just as mighty sentinels exist to uphold the virtuous aspects of order, some individuals aim to expand and secure the more virtuous aspects of freedom across the world. Oftentimes pledging themselves to Xaray, Wesmir, and Etivia, these paragon freemen seek to defend the self-determination of others wherever it may be threatened.

Code of Conduct

A paragon freeman must be of chaotic good alignment and loses all class features except proficiencies if she ever willingly commits an evil act. Additionally, a paragon freeman’s code requires that she uphold the dignity and natural rights of creatures above legal doctrine or authority. This entails that she helps those in need (provided they do not use the help for evil or overly authoritative ends), and stops those who harm or threaten innocents. A paragon freeman may associate with evil characters but may not cooperate with them in actions which would threaten the freedom or well-being of the innocent.

This replaces a paladin’s normal code of conduct.

Skills

The paragon freeman adds Bluff to her list of class skills instead of Knowledge (nobility).

This alters the paladin’s normal class skills.

Divine Bond

When forging a divine bond with a weapon, a paragon freeman cannot grant the axiomatic special ability to her weapon. She is capable of granting the anarchic special ability to her weapon with this ability instead.

This ability alters divine bond but may be altered or replaced by other archetypes which affect divine bond.
